reviewNotes.fields.complexion: Drafted as the usual word for skin tone / complexion (રંગ); a native reader should confirm.
reviewNotes.sections.horoscope: Drafted as કુંડળી વિગત; જન્માક્ષર is also used.
reviewNotes.sections.education: અભ્યાસ, as Gujarati biodatas print it; શિક્ષણ is the formal word.
reviewNotes.sections.references: Drafted as સંદર્ભ (people who vouch for the family).
reviewNotes.fields.gender: લિંગ; Gujarati forms also write જાતિ, avoided here so it isn't read as caste.
reviewNotes.fields.caste: જ્ઞાતિ, the usual Gujarati word; સમાજ is often used for the same thing.
reviewNotes.fields.maternalGotra: Drafted as મોસાળનું ગોત્ર (maternal home's gotra).
reviewNotes.fields.manglik: માંગલિક; મંગળ / મંગળ દોષ is also written.
reviewNotes.fields.university: Borrowed યુનિવર્સિટી, as families write it; વિશ્વવિદ્યાલય is formal.
reviewNotes.fields.lagnam: લગ્ન રાશિ, so it isn't read as લગ્ન (marriage).
reviewNotes.fields.kulaDevata: કુળદેવી, as Gujarati families almost always say (a goddess); કુળદેવતા for a god.
reviewNotes.fields.muslimSect: Generic પંથ for a sect; a reviewer may prefer another word per community.
reviewNotes.fields.jainSect: સંપ્રદાય; Jain families may also list their ગચ્છ.
reviewNotes.options.maritalStatus.widowed: Gendered pair વિધુર / વિધવા printed together.
reviewNotes.options.employmentType.business: વેપાર; ધંધો is the everyday word.
reviewNotes.relations.brotherInLaw: બનેવી is the sister's husband; સાળો / દિયર are other brothers-in-law.
reviewNotes.relations.sisterInLaw: ભાભી is the brother's wife; સાળી / નણંદ are other sisters-in-law.
reviewNotes.relations.grandfather: દાદા / દાદી are paternal; નાના / નાની maternal.
reviewNotes.relations.paternalUncle: કાકા is the father's brother (મોટા કાકા / નાના કાકા by age).
reviewNotes.relations.uncle: કાકા, also the general Gujarati word for an uncle (same as paternal uncle).
reviewNotes.relations.aunt: કાકી, the general Gujarati word for an aunt.
reviewNotes.relations.cousin: પિતરાઈ (paternal cousin), commonly used for any cousin; મામાનો / માસીનો દીકરો are specific.
reviewNotes.titles.marriageBiodata: લગ્ન બાયોડેટા; લગ્ન માટે બાયોડેટા is also common.
reviewNotes.words.am: Kept as AM/PM; સવારે / સાંજે before the time is an alternative.
reviewNotes.fields.intiPeru: Step 2.0 (Telugu chip): the family name a Telugu biodata prints before the given name (ఇంటి పేరు); drafted as the usual word for 'surname'.
reviewNotes.fields.devak: Step 2.0 (Marathi chip): the family's devak (clan totem); transliterated.
reviewNotes.fields.gan: Step 2.0: gana used in guna matching (Deva / Manushya / Rakshasa).
reviewNotes.fields.maslak: Step 2.0 (Muslim chip): school or jamaat (Hanafi, Deobandi, Barelvi…); transliterated.
reviewNotes.titles.bioData: Step 2.0: the hyphenated 'Bio-Data' spelling many printed biodatas use.
